title: Demographic Targeting Capability
description: Product-scoped demographic execution capability. This declaration is product-scoped because one seller may route products through different ad servers. Buyers compare a requested canonical predicate with these capabilities before purchase; sellers MUST reject or return explicit alternatives when they cannot compile the predicate exactly.

age.description: Age-targeting execution available for this product.

execution_modes.description: Ways this product can execute canonical age intent. continuous_bounds accepts any integer bounds inside the declared domain; enumerated_intervals accepts exact unions of the declared intervals; signals resolves through signals carrying authoritative demographic_predicate metadata.

min_supported_age.description: Lowest inclusive bound accepted by continuous_bounds. Required when that execution mode is declared.

max_supported_age.description: Highest inclusive bound accepted by continuous_bounds. Required when that execution mode is declared.

unknown_handling.description: How this product handles people whose age is unavailable. selectable honors either include_unknown value; always_excluded supports only false; always_included supports only true. A seller MUST reject a request incompatible with this declaration rather than silently changing it.

intervals.description: Seller-owned age intervals available to enumerated_intervals execution. Bounds are authoritative capability data, not a protocol-wide bucket taxonomy. Exact compilation may union adjacent intervals but MUST NOT introduce gaps or extra ages.

interval_id.description: Seller-scoped interval identifier echoed in demographic targeting readback.
